  - Highest point: Mount Whitney Summit, 14,505 feet (4,421 meters)
  - Lowest point: Crescent Meadow, 6,700 feet (2,042 meters)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant described trail conditions for the High Sierra Trail, including rugged terrain, steep ascents and descents, river crossings, and potential snow and ice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant outlined the physical demands of the High Sierra Trail, including carrying a heavy backpack, hiking for 8-10 hours per day, and dealing with altitude sickness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided preparation and planning tips for the High Sierra Trail, including extensive backpacking experience, understanding wilderness first aid, and obtaining a permit.
